embeds.title: 🔴 VS Code Vulnerability Allows One-Click GitHub Token Theft
embeds.description:
Security researcher Ammar Askar disclosed a severe Visual Studio Code vulnerability that can be exploited to steal a user's GitHub token and access their repositories. The vulnerability involves a specially crafted Jupyter notebook that, when opened on github.dev, uses hidden code to simulate keystrokes and install a malicious extension that steals the victim's GitHub access token. Microsoft patched the web version on June 3, but the desktop version reportedly remains unpatched.
**Sources:** SecurityWeek • 🔴 1 corroborating
